convention: Each observation is one complete use in a fresh Python process. Both methods pay cold physical kernels, preparation, encoding, shared exact8 feature construction, compilation, family JSON serialization/parsing/checking, queries and compact decision construction/serialization/parsing/checking. Only finite_context8 imports NumPy/SciPy, inside its timed compiler: cold imports, first solver initialization, all numerical cone proposals and exact rational support recovery are included. Methods alternate order within each of three repetitions. Report both the sum of component medians and the median of complete-use totals. Interpreter startup, common standard-library/project-module imports, process transport and optional frontier export are outside both totals. No precomputed cones enter either timed pipeline.
reuse_estimate_convention: The reused_checked_frontier fields are component-based estimates formed from first-use observations, not separately executed reuse trials. They assume the verified frontier and physical model remain available and valid.
